in_hebrew.name: יד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Jed or Yed is derived from the Hebrew word yad which means hand. It is a common name in the Bible, appearing in various contexts.

in_greek.name: Ιδούς
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Idoús is derived from the Greek word idou, which means 'behold' or 'see'. It is not directly related to the Hebrew name Jed, but it shares a similar meaning of 'revealing' or 'manifesting'.

in_latin.name: Iudas
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Iudas is derived from the Hebrew word yehudah, which means 'Judean'. This name is most famous for being the name of Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus in the New Testament.
